GRADE 5 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERM 1 EXAM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 30 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Medicinal Trees at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. list the most common medicinal plants for familiarisation,
   B. Learners should ignore Medicinal Trees completely.
   C. Medicinal Trees is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Medicinal Trees.

2. About Medicinal Trees at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use,
   B. Learners should ignore Medicinal Trees completely.
   C. Medicinal Trees is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Medicinal Trees.

3. About Medicinal Trees when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Nurture the medicinal plants for preservation of environment,
   B. Learners should ignore Medicinal Trees completely.
   C. Medicinal Trees is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Medicinal Trees.

5. About Scriptural Stories and Family Values at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the teachings of Scriptures at family level for development of moral values,
   B. Learners should ignore Scriptural Stories and Family Values completely.
   C. Scriptural Stories and Family Values is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Scriptural Stories and Family Values.

6. About Scriptural Stories and Family Values at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate the teachings that promote moral values in families as per selected Scriptures from the four faiths,
   B. Learners should ignore Scriptural Stories and Family Values completely.
   C. Scriptural Stories and Family Values is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Scriptural Stories and Family Values.

7. About Scriptural Stories and Family Values when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the teachings of Scriptures at family level for development of moral values,
   B. Learners should ignore Scriptural Stories and Family Values completely.
   C. Scriptural Stories and Family Values is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Scriptural Stories and Family Values.

9. Which habit helps you revise HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

10. Which habit helps you revise HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

11. Which habit helps you revise HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

12. Which habit helps you revise HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Medicinal Trees at home with your family.
